gloss: food and drink, eating and drinking

definitions.gloss: food and drink, eating and drinking
definitions.explanation: The act of eating and drinking, or food and beverages together.

examples.japanese: ここは{飲食|いんしょく}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Eating and drinking are prohibited here.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧の⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧に⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧が⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many restaurants near the station.

examples.japanese: {飲食|いんしょく}を⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
{飲食|いんしょく}{業|ぎょう}で⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work in the food and beverage industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧では{飲食|いんしょく}が⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧されている⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧で⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Eating and drinking are prohibited in the library, so I ate outside.

notes:
{飲食|いんしょく} is a formal compound meaning "eating and drinking" or "food and drink." It is used primarily on signs, in regulations, and in industry terminology rather than casual conversation.

FORMS:
{飲|いん} (drink) + {食|しょく} (eat).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧: restaurant, eatery
- {飲食|いんしょく}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no food or drink allowed
- {飲食|いんしょく}{業|ぎょう}: food and beverage industry
- {飲食|いんしょく}{物|ぶつ}: food and drink items
- {飲食|いんしょく}{費|ひ}: food and drink expenses

REGISTER:
Formal. In everyday speech, ⟦{食|た}べたり→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{飲|の}んだりする→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ is more natural. {飲食|いんしょく} is the word you see on signs in libraries, trains, and museums.
